metadata.title: Timelike Supersymmetric Geometries in Seven-Dimensional Supergravity
metadata.abstract: Seven-dimensional supergravity poses a uniquely intricate supersymmetry problem, combining topologically massive higher-form gauge dynamics, distinct Clifford algebra properties, and rich geometric structures. We first establish the complete formulation of the maximal Cartan-gauged theory in terms of the gauge-invariant higher-form flux, including both the bosonic action and supersymmetry variations. This formulation, which also makes the smooth ungauged limit manifest, is achieved by requiring a consistent truncation to the minimal Cartan-gauged theory in the equal-charge limit. We construct the complete bilinear system for a timelike Killing vector, where additional internal orientation of the symplectic-Majorana spinor arises already in the scalar sector, uniquely among pure minimal ungauged theories. In the equal-charge sector, we decouple the algebraic constraints into SU$(3)$-isotypic components, and analyse the differential bilinear relations, determining the permitted dilaton gradient, fluxes, fibration twist and intrinsic torsion of the base. We prove that with gauging and active Cartan flux, the complex scalar bilinear vanishes identically. We also construct a Killing gauge for the higher-form potential compatible with the self-duality condition. We show that with gauging but no active Cartan flux, the Killing vector also acts as a generator of the gauged R-symmetry, and the base structure is enlarged from SU$(3)$ to U$(3)$. We find that BPS-flow solutions realize this setting. With supersymmetry, we isolate a single independent component of the 3-form equation across an exhaustive four-class partition for both theories within this setup. Applied to known and proposed solutions in both theories, this classification exposes unexplored sectors and provides an accessible toolbox for constructing and testing solutions and developing new geometric and holographic applications.

analysis.workSummary: 研究七维超引力中 timelike Killing 向量对应的双线性系统及六维底空间结构。
techniques: Cartan 规范化与高阶通量
Killing 规范与自对偶约束
analysis.breakthrough: 在指定两种理论和分支内整理通量、扭曲、dilaton 与内蕴挠率约束，并识别从 SU(3) 到 U(3) 的结构变化。
analysis.limitations: 限定 timelike 设置、相应理论及等荷等扇区，不能称为所有七维超对称解的完整分类；物理双线性不直接给出一般黎曼流形定理。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。唯一命中位于规范理论的场变量变换公式，AI 是带指标的规范势符号；该段没有作者使用人工智能的声明。已检索完整版本，未见正面披露。
